# HOL Council — ch02 Character Creation

Chapter under review: ch02 (quarto-book/chapters/02-character-creation.qmd), "Creating Your Hero", 579 lines. The book's character-creation chapter: two-phase creation (Level 0 Background then Level 1 Class), Steps 1-11, quick-build sidebar, the worked example of Makeva Quickfoot (lines 228-266), and eight build templates (Mage: Arcanist/Intellect, Priest: Shepherd/Leader, Thief: Blade/Shadow, Fighter: Protector/Unbalanced, lines 270-579). These templates are the canonical stat anchors for the party and the primary DP-math worked examples in the book; ch08's discipline examples reference them ("Sera the Arcanist... 1 Fire and 1 Energy at creation", ch08:204-210).

Task: audit the chapter as a publishable unit and produce a disposition plan. Each member audits through their own lens (see role card) and files ONE finding:
  stance support = the chapter holds on this lens as written
  stance refute  = the chapter must change; name the fix and its scope
Findings cite [02-character-creation.qmd:line]. Mechanics findings state the broken value and the expected value.

Cross-chapter canon anchors (use the AUTHORITATIVE chapters as reference, not this chapter):
- class starting bundles + signature texts = ch05 (05-classes.qmd) — the class chapters' authoritative phrasing. E.g. the Blade's signature (ch05:88) is "Swift Blade: use Agility instead of Brawn when attacking with blades. Gain the Precise Stab ability, bonus damage when exploiting an opening"; the Protector's "Bastion: Spend your movement to enter a defensive stance. Add +1 to your Protection Value for the round" (ch05:49); the Unbalanced's "Edge of Chaos: On a Strong hit, deal +1 damage tier (one row up on the damage budget) but roll on the d6 Backlash Table" (ch05:336) — this was locked in PR #331, killing the old "+4 bonus damage" flat rider.
- discipline taxonomy = ch08 (08-disciplines.qmd): 23 Disciplines in 9 categories. "Starting disciplines from ancestry, culture, and class are always rank 1 in distinct disciplines. You may not spend both picks on the same discipline to start with rank 2" (ch08:83).
- class cost tables = ch05 class sections (Protector ch05:60-71, Blade ch05:96-107, Arcanist ch05:140-151, Shepherd ch05:171-190, Intellect ch05:210-228, Odd ch05:258-272, Leader ch05:305-317, Unbalanced ch05:349-368, Shadow ch05:400-412). Home 1/2/4, Adjacent 2/4/8, Foreign 3/6/12, Opposed 4/8/16.
- class favored-skill lists = ch05 (Protector ch05:51, Blade ch05:90, Arcanist ch05:135, Shepherd ch05:174, Intellect ch05:213, Odd ch05:252, Leader ch05:293, Unbalanced ch05:349, Shadow ch05:396).
- class starting kits = ch05 class sections (e.g. Protector ch05:54, Blade ch05:92, Shadow ch05:398).
- movement canon = ch03:68: "30 feet per round for most heroes. Dwarves and halflings move 25 feet, heavy armor slows you by 5 feet".
- HP canon = ch02 Table 2.3 itself (10 + Fortitude + Knowledge at L1); Dwarf Sturdy +2 max HP (ch04:63/66).
- skills roster = ch07:108-156 (Survival is Fortitude, Endurance is Fortitude, Perception is Reason, Craft is Reason, etc.). The 22-skill roster (ch07 header).
- signature flavor: Ch05 signatures carry unlocked ability names (e.g. Swift Blade unlocks Precise Stab as a named ability).
- decisions-pending context: #16 (2026-08-15, implemented) changed Priest kits to leather armor (DR 2) — verify templates reflect leather, not chain shirt; #17 (implemented) added the movement row 30 ft with dwarf/halfling 25 ft and heavy-armor -5 ft notes — Table 2.3's Movement row should already carry it; #18 (implemented) rank-2 deepening at creation is allowed ("2 same" shape, rank costs per class table); #22 (resolved) Edge of Chaos is "+1 damage tier", never "+4 bonus damage"; ch02 Wave-1 (PR #306, 2026-08-15) fixed stale ancestry lines, Turn Undead->Turn Unholy, spell names Mending Touch/Sanctuary, Intellect any-pick, Gorma Blades->Protection rank 1, movement row, focus pouch renames, Arcane Shield "+1 Protection Value", and misapplied "favored" tags x3.

Book conventions every lens applies: zero em-dashes (restructure sentences, never find-replace); flat damage budgets Novice 2/4/6, Adept 6/9/12, Master 9/15/21; card costs flat 2/4/8 DP; one-roll principle; no stale retired vocabulary (DA not GM, class names from the 9-class roster, spell/ability names must exist in the spell chapters or ch05/ch09 tables); placeholder art is acceptable in a draft.

Specific areas worth checking (findings are yours to file or dismiss):
- Every template's derived stats: HP = 10 + Fort + Know (+2 if Dwarf), Initiative = Agility mod, Movement = 30 ft (25 dwarf/halfling, -5 heavy armor), Carry = 10 + Brawn x 5. Check Makeva (Halfling, line 262: "Movement 30 ft"), Haldra (Dwarf Hill, line 385), Gorma (Dwarf Mountain heavy armor, line 538 "Movement 20 ft"), Pip (Halfling, line 499), and all nine templates against the formulas and the character's own attributes/armor.
- Every template's class signature wording vs ch05's signature line: Sera Arcanist (line 294), Lirael Intellect (line 333), Haldra Shepherd (line 372), Marta Leader (line 410), Vaelith Blade (line 448), Pip Shadow (line 486), Gorma Protector (line 525), Corwin Unbalanced (line 564). Watch specifically for the Edge of Chaos phrasing in Corwin's template (line 564) — "+4 bonus damage" is the dead flat rider; ch05:336 says "+1 damage tier".
- Class Discipline claims in each template vs ch05/ch08 class bundles (line 249 Odd "Blades and Water", line 294 Arcanist "1 Fire, 1 Energy", line 333 Intellect "1 Lore, 1 any (takes Tactics)", line 372 Shepherd "Protection + Animal", line 410 Leader "Tactics + Protection", line 448 Blade "Blades + Stealth", line 486 Shadow "Stealth + Sleight", line 525 Protector "any Weapon + Armor", line 564 Unbalanced "Fire + Water"). An Unbalanced human who picks Fire for the human ancestry AND gets Fire from the class would start with 2 Fire from two free picks — against ch08:83's "rank 1 in distinct disciplines... not both picks on the same discipline"? Check each template's ancestry/culture/class overlap against ch08:83.
- Cost/DP arithmetic in each template: background DP = 8 + Knowledge + Fortitude, class DP = 8, Human Versatile = +1 DP at Level 0. Verify the totals column ("Total: X DP. All spent.") matches the sum of purchases and the DP pool in every template and in Makeva's worked example. Watch "favored" tags: only skills on the class's ch05 favored list may be tagged favored (Arcanist: Alchemy/Arcana/History/Lore/Nature; Leader: Persuasion/Perception/Insight/Survival/Endurance; check each).
- Discipline-rank purchases in background DP vs the class's cost table: Marta Leader "Blades Discipline, rank 2 (2 DP)" (line 403), Vaelith Blade "Sleight Discipline, rank 1 (1 DP)" (line 444), Gorma Protector "Protection Discipline, rank 1 (1 DP)" (line 521), Haldra Shepherd "Life Discipline, rank 1 (1 DP)" (line 368). Verify against ch05 cost tables and #18 rank-2 rules.
- Ability names bought in class DP must exist as real cards (ch05 tables or spell chapters). Verify Ember Lance/Burning Volley (Arcanist), Mending Touch/Sanctuary (Shepherd), Exploit Chaos/Improvised Solution (Odd), Interpose/Parry (Protector), Sap/Perception/Acrobatics (Shadow), Precise Stab's existence (Blade signature references it — does a Precise Stab card exist anywhere in ch05/ch09/ch11/ch12?), Rallying Cry/Tactical Insight/Force Dart, etc.
- Kit line vs the class's ch05 starting kit: Sera (line 305), Lirael (line 344), Haldra (line 383), Marta (line 421), Vaelith (line 459), Pip (line 497), Gorma (line 536), Corwin (line 575), Makeva (line 260). Watch leather armor for the two Priests, focus pouch/spellbook/holy symbol matches, and any "component pouch" leftovers (renamed to focus pouch in #309).
- Culture discipline grants: each culture line in the templates should record the culture's granted Disciplines (per the Step 4 culture table in this chapter) or the free discipline for adaptable cultures; e.g. Sera Imperial "Free Discipline: Energy" (line 282), Lirael High Elf "Energy + Blades" (line 321). Check whether each template records its culture disciplines, and whether the culture grant duplicates an ancestry/class grant against ch08:83.
- Makeva worked example: DP math (lines 240-258), class line "Gains 2 Disciplines from different categories (Blades and Water)" (line 249) — Makeva is a Halfling whose ancestry grants Blades; does the Odd class grant stack or duplicate? Does the example's Step 4 culture line record Riverfolk's disciplines? Check consistency with ch08:83 and ch05's Odd.
- Ancestry/culture trait references: Lucky (Halfling), Sturdy (Dwarf), Elven Grace, Versatile — and any "boon" usage (a boon = extra d6, ch06; "add one boon" is the ch04 trait phrasing).
- Cross-chapter contamination: class-name references, spell/ability names, armor DR values (chain mail DR 5 per ch16:39; leather DR 2 per ch16:34; robes DR 0 if referenced — verify a "robes" armor entry exists or note it), and skill names vs ch07.
- The chapter's own rules text vs its templates: does Step 5's "What You Can Buy" table allow everything the templates buy (rank-2 deepening is addressed in Step 5 prose line 136; verify the table or prose covers Discipline first rank AND rank-2 deepening)? Do the quick-build and two-phase callouts match the worked examples?
- Layout/presentation: heading hierarchy (## vs ###), table formatting, the pagebreak usage, callout structure, any render issues you can verify by grepping the .qmd (e.g., the anchor label block at lines 3-5 duplicates the heading anchor — that is the book-wide pattern, verify before flagging).

Disposition tiers (the librarian synthesizes these in the recommendation):
  TIER 1 mechanical — chapter-local, zero mechanics change, no content judgment (heading/label, wording, em-dashes, table rows, stale refs, page flow).
  TIER 2 substantive — rewrites or multi-sentence fixes that change content but not rules (a line rephrased to match canon, a paragraph restructured).
  TIER 3 design decisions — anything that touches rules, canon identities, or book-wide convention; route to decisions-pending for Bruce, with a recommended default.
